pin_regs.reason: KV-RTRUNK: a result-trunk station is ONE register stage pin to pin (inject: a / y -> 2:1 -> flop -> b; header: trunk words -> AND / 2:1 -> flop -> beat word); its flop is the pin register of every pin; pv_trunk_gen counts exactly 1 core cycle per station (RS_D), so a flow-inserted pin register would change the static beat schedule; KV-KITS/NATIVE 10-18: the native successor registers / replicates its select pins in RTL instead

job.purpose: KV-KITS/NATIVE 10-18: PV result-trunk INJECT station with its select registered at the pin (s_r <= s; b <= s_r ? y : a; the generator drives s one T-chain edge earlier), 21.6 x 95.04 um, 64 per pair; successor of qkd_rlyi_258 (native capture s 259.3 > 190)

structural_change: KV-KITS/NATIVE 10-18: native-pin successor of qkd_rlyi_258 (CLOSED, not die-bindable: native capture FAIL on its select pins only). qkd_rlyi_258 s pin fanned out to 258 muxes (S + R 259.3 ps); here s feeds one pin flop.
